summary:
Comprehensive testing of the newly-added Doc module (letterhead PDF renderer + docx/pdf/txt importer). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_doc_module.py — 24 pytest cases, ALL 24 PASS (29.9s). Coverage: (a) auth gating: 401 on all three /api/doc/* endpoints unauthenticated; (b) preview/generate parity: single-page counts, empty-html -> 400, filename fallback to BluBridge_Document_.pdf, page-count between /preview and /generate matches for the same payload; (c) PyMuPDF programmatic inspection: every one of a 5+ page generated PDF carries the same letterhead drawings + images (>=ref values) as static/doc/Letterhead_Curve.pdf; (d) paragraph keep-together: PARA_i_START and PARA_i_END markers land on the SAME page across 24 paragraphs spanning multiple pages; (e) content stays inside safe area (y0>=112, y1<=786) for every drawn block; (f) heading keep-with-next: UNIQUE_HEADING_XYZ and its following UNIQUE_BODY_XYZ paragraph land on same page when the heading falls near a page boundary; (g) long table (40 rows): every row's 3 cells appear together on exactly one page (no cuts) and the H_ALPHA/H_BETA/H_GAMMA header row repeats on every continuation page; (h) signature: image bbox inside safe area (y1<=786, y0>=112) on the page it lands; (i) import: .docx preserves

, , , ,
    ,
      , with correct content; .txt reflows to

      per blank-line-separated paragraph; .pdf extracts text; .xlsx rejected with 415; (j) history integration: 'doc' entry saved with name field, listed under /api/history?type=doc, /api/history/{id}/download returns 200 application/pdf starting with %PDF magic; (k) REGRESSION: /api/template/generate, /api/offer/generate, /api/ack/generate, /api/offer-email/preview, /api/health all still return 200. Frontend UI smoke: logged in as admin/pass123, verified menu order = [certificate, offer, offer-email, offer-appoint, ack, notif-email, history, doc] (Doc IS last), clicked menu-doc -> doc-view rendered, filled doc-name + injected editor HTML, clicked doc-generate-preview -> doc-preview-page-1 appeared with 'Page 1 of 1' counter, doc-download + doc-print buttons present. History tab shows 'Doc' filter chip AND newly-created 'Letterhead Document' entry.

issues: Uses browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) for 'Date (Letter)' and 'Joining Date' instead of the shadcn calendar component — inconsistent with a professional HR product. Not a regression (pre-existing), but worth polishing when the app moves to shadcn <Calendar/> for all date fields.

ui_smoke: Menu order verified: Doc is LAST after History
Doc view renders, preview generates 'Page 1 of 1'

critical_code_review_comments: doc_builder.py — solid design. Preview and PDF share the identical layout engine (insert_htmlbox) which guarantees preview==PDF. `_measure_cache` is unbounded (a dict keyed on HTML fragments); low risk because keys are per-request unique, but a `functools.lru_cache(maxsize=512)` wrapper would be safer if a user submits huge documents in a hot loop.

doc_builder.py::_split_oversized strips HTML tags via a regex and re-emits plain

chunks — inline formatting (bold/italic/underline) is silently lost when a single paragraph is taller than a full page. Rare edge case, but worth documenting in the UI or falling back to line-wise splitting that preserves runs.
server.py::doc_import catches broad Exception and returns 400 with the raw exception string — could leak stack details. Consider a fixed generic message with the details logged server-side only.
server.py has swelled to ~1100 lines mixing 7 feature modules. Splitting into routers/{doc,offer,notif,...}.py would improve maintainability (already breaches the internal >700-line guideline).
seed_data_creation: 5 TEST_-prefixed 'doc' history rows created during the test run (TEST_QA, TEST_match, TEST_5page, TEST_keep, TEST_safe, TEST_head, TEST_table, TEST_sig, TEST_hist_doc) + one regression certificate/offer/ack row. Safe to leave; can be bulk-deleted from the History tab via the delete button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_doc_module.py is the source of truth for Doc regression. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_doc_module.py -v` before any change that touches doc_builder.py or the /api/doc/* endpoints — the PyMuPDF-based tests directly assert the four hard requirements (no paragraph split, heading-with-next, table row integrity, letterhead on every page). SendGrid endpoints were NOT exercised (per E1's instruction 'do not click Send'). Offer Letter (Email) 'oe-cc-chip-*' + 'oe-send-cc' and notif-cc-chip-* live inside the Send panel modal that appears only after a preview is generated with a full valid payload — they are correctly guarded by the modal, not visible on the initial form load (that's why an initial-page query_selector for them returned MISSING; not a bug).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the feature under test. All 8 QA requirements from the review request verified programmatically with PyMuPDF: paragraph keep-together ✓, heading keep-with-next ✓, table row integrity + header repeat ✓, letterhead on every page (drawings+images match reference) ✓, signature inside safe area + moves to next page when it doesn't fit ✓, content stays inside y=[112, 786] ✓, preview page-count matches PDF page-count ✓, importer handles docx/pdf/txt + rejects xlsx with 415 ✓.
